description:
If it were like the original, this country would be destroyed?

A supporting character in the book, I reincarnated as the princess of a country that would soon be destroyed.

The reason for the destruction?
The female protagonist asked for a map, but the tyrant emperor took what his finger was pointing to as the 'country' on the map, not the 'map'!

"That was the map I wanted!"

"You just wanted the paper with the map drawn on it? 

"Why?"

"Because the gold frame is pretty..."

I want to kill those guys. To prevent the destruction of my country and save my life, I went to the empire to sign a peace treaty.

However, life did not always go as planned.

The condition of the peace treaty that the empire's nobles insisted on was a marriage alliance.

"Grant the princess to the victorious general who won without shedding a drop of blood, Your Majesty."

Aaaah!!!! No, that's not right! Let me be the empress's maid instead!
